<function name="IsCurrentSchedule" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether or not the NPC is performing the given schedule.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="schedule" type="number">The schedule number, see <page>Enums/SCHED</page>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">True if the NPC is performing the given schedule, false otherwise.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Function which returns the schedule an NPC is performing.</description>
	<code>
function GetNPCSchedule(npc)

	if(!IsValid(npc)) then return end
	
	for s = 0, LAST_SHARED_SCHEDULE-1 do
		if(npc:IsCurrentSchedule(s)) then return s end
	end
	
	return 0
	
end
	</code>

</example>
